scope: Partial queue snapshot; all already-verified quantifier/reference conventions for its frozen 296 study/run entries

reference.name: ME49_host
reference.note: kallisto index rebuilt separately at a 40 GB cap after the first build was killed at 16 GB (peak 27 GB).

precision: Gene count, TPM and effective length stored as float32; full precision inputs retained externally
normalization: Sum transcript counts and TPM by exact tx2gene mapping; drop HOST: genes; reclose parasite TPM to 1e6
missingness: Missing genes remain NaN; measured zeros remain zero
limitations: Descriptive expression. Partial studies may lack controls. Cross-study TPM is not batch-corrected. Alternative strain references retain their own exact gene identifiers.
effective_lengths: Included in the GitHub data pack
